passages.text: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years.
passages.sermon: Josiah became king when he was eight years old.\r\nJosiah ruled in Jerusalem.\r\nHe ruled for thirty-one years.
passages.original: בֶּן־ שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִ֖ים יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְאַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in the ways of his father David; he did not turn aside to the right or to the left.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
Josiah did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
Josiah followed the ways of his ancestor David.
Josiah did not turn aside to the right.
Josiah did not turn aside to the left.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּדַרְכֵי֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔יו וְלֹא־ סָ֖ר יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃

passages.text: In the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, Josiah began to seek the God of his father David, and in the twelfth year he began to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem of the high places, the Asherah poles, the carved idols, and the cast images.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah and Jerusalem.
Josiah became king when he was eight years old.
Josiah was still a young man in the eighth year of his reign.
In that year, Josiah began to seek the God of his father David.
In the twelfth year of his reign, Josiah began to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem.
He removed the high places.
He removed the Asherah poles.
He removed the carved idols.
He removed the cast images.
passages.original: וּבִשְׁמוֹנֶ֨ה שָׁנִ֜ים לְמָלְכ֗וֹ וְהוּא֙ עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ נַ֔עַר הֵחֵ֕ל לִדְר֕וֹשׁ לֵאלֹהֵ֖י דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑יו וּבִשְׁתֵּ֧ים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֗ה הֵחֵל֙ לְטַהֵ֔ר אֶת־ יְהוּדָה֙ וִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מִן־ הַבָּמוֹת֙ וְהָ֣אֲשֵׁרִ֔ים וְהַפְּסִלִ֖ים וְהַמַּסֵּכֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Then in his presence the altars of the Baals were torn down, and he cut to pieces the incense altars that were above them. He shattered the Asherah poles, the carved idols, and the cast images, crushed them to dust, and scattered them over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
Josiah did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
People tore down the altars of the Baals in front of Josiah.
Josiah cut to pieces the incense altars that stood above the Baal altars.
Josiah broke the Asherah poles.
Josiah shattered the carved idols.
Josiah crushed the cast images to dust.
Josiah scattered the dust over the graves of those who had sacrificed to these idols.
passages.original: וַיְנַתְּצ֣וּ לְפָנָ֗יו אֵ֚ת מִזְבְּח֣וֹת הַבְּעָלִ֔ים וְהַֽחַמָּנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ לְמַ֥עְלָה מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם גִּדֵּ֑עַ וְ֠הָאֲשֵׁרִים וְהַפְּסִלִ֤ים וְהַמַּסֵּכוֹת֙ שִׁבַּ֣ר וְהֵדַ֔ק וַיִּזְרֹק֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַקְּבָרִ֔ים הַזֹּבְחִ֖ים לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then he burned the bones of the priests on their altars. So he cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
Josiah wanted to serve God.
Josiah destroyed idols and false altars.
Josiah burned the bones of the priests on their altars.
Josiah cleansed Judah.
Josiah cleansed Jerusalem.
passages.original: וְעַצְמוֹת֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים שָׂרַ֖ף עַל־ מִזְבְּחוֹתָים וַיְטַהֵ֥ר אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְאֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Josiah did the same in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, as far as Naphtali, and in the ruins around them.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
Josiah destroyed idols and pagan altars.
He did this in the cities of Manasseh.
He did this in the cities of Ephraim.
He did this in the cities of Simeon.
He did this as far as Naphtali.
He also did this in the ruins around those cities.
passages.original: וּבְעָרֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֧ה וְאֶפְרַ֛יִם וְשִׁמְע֖וֹן וְעַד־ נַפְתָּלִ֑י בְּהַר בָּתֵּיהֶם סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: He tore down the altars and Asherah poles, crushed the idols to powder, and cut to pieces all the incense altars throughout the land of Israel. Then he returned to Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
Josiah acted to remove idolatry from Israel.
Josiah tore down the altars.
Josiah tore down the Asherah poles.
Josiah crushed the idols to powder.
Josiah cut to pieces all the incense altars.
Josiah did this throughout the land of Israel.
Josiah returned to Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיְנַתֵּ֣ץ אֶת־ הַֽמִּזְבְּח֗וֹת וְאֶת־ הָאֲשֵׁרִ֤ים וְהַפְּסִלִים֙ כִּתַּ֣ת לְהֵדַ֔ק וְכָל־ הַֽחַמָּנִ֥ים גִּדַּ֖ע בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּ֖שָׁב לִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

passages.text: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, in order to cleanse the land and the temple, Josiah sent Shaphan son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah son of Joahaz, the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
In the eighteenth year of his reign, Josiah wanted to cleanse the land and the temple.
Josiah sent three men to do this work.
He sent Shaphan son of Azaliah.
He sent Maaseiah, who was the governor of the city.
He sent Joah son of Joahaz, who was the recorder.
Josiah sent them to repair the house of the LORD his God.
passages.original: וּבִשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ לְמָלְכ֔וֹ לְטַהֵ֥ר הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהַבָּ֑יִת שָׁ֠לַח אֶת־ שָׁפָ֨ן בֶּן־ אֲצַלְיָ֜הוּ וְאֶת־ מַעֲשֵׂיָ֣הוּ שַׂר־ הָעִ֗יר וְ֠אֵת יוֹאָ֤ח בֶּן־ יֽוֹאָחָז֙ הַמַּזְכִּ֔יר לְחַזֵּ֕ק אֶת־ בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃

passages.text: So they went to Hilkiah the high priest and gave him the money that had been brought into the house of God, which the Levites at the doors had collected from the people of Manasseh and Ephraim, from all the remnant of Israel, Judah, and Benjamin, and from the people of Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
He wanted to repair the temple of the LORD.
He sent officials to organize the work.
These officials went to Hilkiah.
Hilkiah was the high priest.
The officials gave Hilkiah money.
People had brought this money into the house of God.
The Levites had collected this money.
The Levites stood at the doors of the temple.
They collected money from the people of Manasseh.
They collected money from the people of Ephraim.
They collected money from all the remaining people of Israel.
They collected money from the people of Judah.
They collected money from the people of Benjamin.
They collected money from the people living in Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ אֶל־ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ׀ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֗וֹל וַֽיִּתְּנוּ֮ אֶת־ הַכֶּסֶף֮ הַמּוּבָ֣א בֵית־ אֱלֹהִים֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָסְפֽוּ־ הַלְוִיִּם֩ שֹׁמְרֵ֨י הַסַּ֜ף מִיַּ֧ד מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה וְאֶפְרַ֗יִם וּמִכֹּל֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִכָּל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן וְיֹשְׁבֵי יְרֽוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: They put it into the hands of the supervisors of those doing the work of the house of the LORD, who in turn gave it to the workmen restoring and repairing the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The supervisors managed the work in the house of the LORD.
They received the money.
They gave the money to the workmen.
The workmen worked in the house of the LORD.
The workmen inspected the house.
The workmen repaired the house.
passages.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ עַל־ יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה הַמֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ עוֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹשִׂים֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לִבְדּ֥וֹק וּלְחַזֵּ֖ק הַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: They also gave money to the carpenters and builders to buy dressed stone, as well as timbers for couplings and beams for the buildings that the kings of Judah had allowed to deteriorate.
passages.sermon:
The people gave money to the carpenters.
They gave money to the builders.
The carpenters and builders used the money to buy cut stones.
They also bought wood for joining parts together.
They bought beams for the buildings.
The kings of Judah had let these buildings become damaged.
The carpenters and builders repaired these buildings.
passages.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ לֶחָֽרָשִׁים֙ וְלַבֹּנִ֔ים לִקְנוֹת֙ אַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב וְעֵצִ֖ים לַֽמְחַבְּר֑וֹת וּלְקָרוֹת֙ אֶת־ הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁחִ֖יתוּ מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: And the men did the work faithfully. The Levites overseeing them were Jahath and Obadiah, descendants of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, descendants of Kohath. Other Levites, all skilled with musical instruments, were over the laborers and supervised all who did the work, task by task. Some of the Levites were secretaries, officers, and gatekeepers.
passages.sermon:
The men worked faithfully.
Jahath and Obadiah were Levites from the family of Merari.
Zechariah and Meshullam were Levites from the family of Kohath.
These Levites supervised the workers.
Other Levites also helped oversee the work.
These Levites understood how to use musical instruments.
They were in charge of the laborers.
They directed everyone who worked, task by task.
Some Levites served as secretaries.
Some Levites served as officers.
Some Levites served as gatekeepers.
passages.original: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֩ עֹשִׂ֨ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֜ה בַּמְּלָאכָ֗ה וַעֲלֵיהֶ֣ם׀ מֻ֠פְקָדִים יַ֣חַת וְעֹבַדְיָ֤הוּ הַלְוִיִּם֙ מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י וּזְכַרְיָ֧ה וּמְשֻׁלָּ֛ם מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י הַקְּהָתִ֖ים לְנַצֵּ֑חַ וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם כָּל־ מֵבִ֖ין בִּכְלֵי־ שִֽׁיר׃ וְעַ֣ל הַסַּבָּלִ֗ים וּֽמְנַצְּחִים֙ לְכֹל֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה מְלָאכָ֔ה לַעֲבוֹדָ֖ה וַעֲבוֹדָ֑ה וּמֵֽהַלְוִיִּ֔ם סוֹפְרִ֥ים וְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים וְשׁוֹעֲרִֽים׃

passages.text: While they were bringing out the money that had been taken into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the LORD written by Moses.
passages.sermon:
Hilkiah was a priest.
Workers brought out money from the house of the LORD.
This money had been collected for repairs.
While they brought out the money, Hilkiah found a book.
This book was the Book of the Law of the LORD.
Moses had written this Book of the Law.
passages.original: וּבְהוֹצִיאָ֣ם אֶת־ הַכֶּ֔סֶף הַמּוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מָצָא֙ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶת־ סֵ֥פֶר תּֽוֹרַת־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: And Hilkiah said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD!” And he gave it to Shaphan.
passages.sermon:
Hilkiah was a priest.
Shaphan was a scribe.
Hilkiah spoke to Shaphan.
Hilkiah said, “I have found the Book of the Law.”
Hilkiah found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD.
Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַן חִלְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ שָׁפָ֣ן הַסּוֹפֵ֔ר סֵ֧פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֛ה מָצָ֖אתִי בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֧ן חִלְקִיָּ֛הוּ אֶת־ הַסֵּ֖פֶר אֶל־ שָׁפָֽן׃

passages.text: Then Shaphan brought the book to the king and reported, “Your servants are doing all that has been placed in their hands.
passages.sermon:
Shaphan was the scribe.
Shaphan brought the book to the king.
Shaphan spoke to the king.
Shaphan said, “Your servants are doing all that you have given them to do.”
passages.original: וַיָּבֵ֨א שָׁפָ֤ן אֶת־ הַסֵּ֙פֶר֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיָּ֨שֶׁב ע֧וֹד אֶת־ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ דָּבָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ נִתַּ֥ן בְּיַד־ עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים׃

passages.text: They have paid out the money that was found in the house of the LORD and have put it into the hands of the supervisors and workers.”
passages.sermon:
The servants found money in the house of the LORD.
They paid out this money.
They gave the money to the supervisors.
They also gave the money to the workers.
passages.original: וַיַּתִּ֕יכוּ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף הַנִּמְצָ֣א בְּבֵית־ יְהוָ֑ה וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּהוּ עַל־ יַד֙ הַמֻּפְקָדִ֔ים וְעַל־ יַ֖ד עוֹשֵׂ֥י הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃

passages.text: Moreover, Shaphan the scribe told the king, “Hilkiah the priest has given me a book.” And Shaphan read it in the presence of the king.
passages.sermon:
Shaphan was the scribe.
He spoke to the king.
He said, “Hilkiah the priest gave me a book.”
Shaphan read the book aloud.
He read it in front of the king.
passages.original: וַיַּגֵּ֞ד שָׁפָ֤ן הַסּוֹפֵר֙ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֔ר סֵ֚פֶר נָ֣תַן לִ֔י חִלְקִיָּ֖הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַיִּקְרָא־ ב֥וֹ שָׁפָ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: When the king heard the words of the Law, he tore his clothes and commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Abdon son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the servant of the king: “Go and inquire of the LORD for me and for those remaining in Israel and Judah concerning the words in the book that has been found. For great is the wrath of the LORD that has been poured out on us because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD by doing all that is written in this book.”
passages.sermon:
King Josiah ruled over Judah.
King Josiah heard the words of the Law.
He listened to the book that was found in the house of the LORD.
He tore his clothes.
He showed deep sorrow and fear.
He called for Hilkiah the priest.
He called for Ahikam son of Shaphan.
He called for Abdon son of Micah.
He called for Shaphan the scribe.
He called for Asaiah, the king’s servant.
He gave them a command.
He said, “Go and ask the LORD for me.”
He said, “Ask for those who remain in Israel and Judah.”
He said, “Ask about the words in the book that was found.”
He said, “The LORD’s anger is great.”
He said, “God’s wrath has been poured out on us.”
He said, “This happened because our fathers did not obey the word of the LORD.”
He said, “They did not do all that is written in this book.”
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַתּוֹרָ֑ה וַיִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת־ בְּגָדָֽיו׃ וַיְצַ֣ו הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת־ חִלְקִיָּ֡הוּ וְאֶת־ אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־ שָׁ֠פָן וְאֶת־ עַבְדּ֨וֹן בֶּן־ מִיכָ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת׀ שָׁפָ֣ן הַסּוֹפֵ֗ר וְאֵ֛ת עֲשָׂיָ֥ה עֶֽבֶד־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵאמֹֽר׃ לְכוּ֩ דִרְשׁ֨וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֜ה בַּעֲדִ֗י וּבְעַד֙ הַנִּשְׁאָר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וּבִֽיהוּדָ֔ה עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַסֵּ֖פֶר אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצָ֑א כִּֽי־ גְדוֹלָ֤ה חֲמַת־ יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִתְּכָ֣ה בָ֔נוּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ שָׁמְר֤וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת כְּכָל־ הַכָּת֖וּב עַל־ הַסֵּ֥פֶר הַזֶּֽה׃פ

passages.text: So Hilkiah and those the king had designated went and spoke to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, the keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem, in the Second District.
passages.sermon:
Hilkiah was a priest.
The king sent Hilkiah and several men on a mission.
These men included those the king had chosen.
They went to Huldah the prophetess.
Huldah was a prophetess.
Huldah was the wife of Shallum.
Shallum was the son of Tokhath.
Tokhath was the son of Hasrah.
Hasrah was the keeper of the wardrobe.
Huldah lived in Jerusalem.
She lived in the Second District of Jerusalem.
Hilkiah and the men spoke to Huldah.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ חִלְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ אֶל־ חֻלְדָּ֨ה הַנְּבִיאָ֜ה אֵ֣שֶׁת׀ שַׁלֻּ֣ם בֶּן־ תּוֹקְהַת בֶּן־ חַסְרָה֙ שׁוֹמֵ֣ר הַבְּגָדִ֔ים וְהִ֛יא יוֹשֶׁ֥בֶת בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וַיְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יהָ כָּזֹֽאת׃ס

passages.text: And Huldah said to them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Tell the man who sent you that this is what the LORD says: I am about to bring calamity on this place and on its people, according to all the curses written in the book that has been read in the presence of the king of Judah, because they have forsaken Me and burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands. My wrath will be poured out upon this place and will not be quenched.’
passages.sermon:
Huldah was a prophetess in Jerusalem.
She spoke to the men sent by the king of Judah.
She said, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says.
Tell the man who sent you these words.
The LORD says, ‘I will bring disaster on this place.
I will bring disaster on its people.
I will do everything written in the book.
The king of Judah heard this book read aloud.
The people have abandoned Me.
They have burned incense to other gods.
They have made Me angry with all their actions.
My anger will burn against this place.
My anger will not be put out.’”
passages.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם כֹּה־ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִמְר֣וּ לָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֥ח אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃ס כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה עַל־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְעַל־ יוֹשְׁבָ֑יו אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הָאָלוֹת֙ הַכְּתוּב֣וֹת עַל־ הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָֽרְא֔וּ לִפְנֵ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃ תַּ֣חַת׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּנִי וַיַּקְטִירוּ לֵֽאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֙עַן֙ הַכְעִיסֵ֔נִי בְּכֹ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְדֵיהֶ֑ם וְתִתַּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֛י בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה׃

passages.text: But as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, tell him that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘As for the words that you heard, because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before God when you heard His words against this place and against its people, and because you have humbled yourself before Me and you have torn your clothes and wept before Me, I have heard you,’ declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The king of Judah sent you to ask the LORD for guidance.
Tell the king this message.
This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says.
You heard My words about this place and its people.
Your heart was tender.
You humbled yourself before God when you heard My words.
You humbled yourself before Me.
You tore your clothes.
You wept before Me.
I have heard you.
This is what the LORD says.
passages.original: וְאֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה הַשֹּׁלֵ֤חַ אֶתְכֶם֙ לִדְר֣וֹשׁ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֖וּ אֵלָ֑יוס כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמָֽעְתָּ׃ יַ֠עַן רַךְ־ לְבָ֨בְךָ֜ וַתִּכָּנַ֣ע׀ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֗ים בְּשָׁמְעֲךָ֤ אֶת־ דְּבָרָיו֙ עַל־ הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ וְעַל־ יֹ֣שְׁבָ֔יו וַתִּכָּנַ֣ע לְפָנַ֔י וַתִּקְרַ֥ע אֶת־ בְּגָדֶ֖יךָ וַתֵּ֣בְךְּ לְפָנָ֑י וְגַם־ אֲנִ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: ‘Now I will indeed gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the calamity that I will bring on this place and on its inhabitants.’ ” So they brought her answer back to the king.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the king of Judah through Huldah the prophetess.
God said, “I will gather you to your fathers.
You will go to your grave in peace.
You will not see the disaster I will bring on this place.
You will not see the disaster I will bring on its people.”
The messengers brought this answer back to the king.
passages.original: הִנְנִ֨י אֹֽסִפְךָ֜ אֶל־ אֲבֹתֶ֗יךָ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ֣ אֶל־ קִבְרֹתֶיךָ֮ בְּשָׁלוֹם֒ וְלֹא־ תִרְאֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹל֙ הָֽרָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י מֵבִ֛יא עַל־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְעַל־ יֹשְׁבָ֑יו וַיָּשִׁ֥יבוּ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ דָּבָֽר׃פ

passages.text: Then the king summoned all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The king acted.
The king sent messengers.
The king called all the elders.
The elders came from Judah.
The elders came from Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֶּאֱסֹ֕ף אֶת־ כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And he went up to the house of the LORD with all the people of Judah and Jerusalem, as well as the priests and the Levites—all the people small and great—and in their hearing he read all the words of the Book of the Covenant that had been found in the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
King Josiah led the people.
He went up to the house of the LORD.
He brought all the people of Judah with him.
He brought all the people living in Jerusalem.
He brought the priests.
He brought the Levites.
He brought all the people, both great and small.
He read aloud to them.
He read all the words from the Book of the Covenant.
They had found this book in the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַל הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית־ יְ֠הוָה וְכָל־ אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם מִגָּד֣וֹל וְעַד־ קָטָ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֣א בְאָזְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַבְּרִ֔ית הַנִּמְצָ֖א בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to follow the LORD and to keep His commandments, decrees, and statutes with all his heart and all his soul, and to carry out the words of this covenant that were written in this book.
passages.sermon:
King Josiah was the ruler of Judah.
He stood by the pillar in the house of the LORD.
He made a covenant before the LORD.
He promised to follow the LORD.
He promised to keep the LORD’s commandments.
He promised to keep the LORD’s decrees.
He promised to keep the LORD’s statutes.
He promised to do this with all his heart.
He promised to do this with all his soul.
He promised to carry out the words of the covenant.
These words were written in the book found in the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֨ד הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ עַל־ עָמְד֗וֹ וַיִּכְרֹ֣ת אֶֽת־ הַבְּרִית֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ לָלֶ֜כֶת אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה וְלִשְׁמ֤וֹר אֶת־ מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וְעֵֽדְוֺתָ֣יו וְחֻקָּ֔יו בְּכָל־ לְבָב֖וֹ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשׁ֑וֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַבְּרִ֔ית הַכְּתוּבִ֖ים עַל־ הַסֵּ֥פֶר הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Then he had everyone in Jerusalem and Benjamin take a stand in agreement to it. So all the people of Jerusalem carried out the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
passages.sermon:
King Josiah ruled in Jerusalem.
He gathered all the people in Jerusalem and Benjamin.
He made everyone in Jerusalem and Benjamin agree to the covenant.
The people of Jerusalem obeyed the covenant of God.
God is the God of their fathers.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֕ד אֵ֛ת כָּל־ הַנִּמְצָ֥א בִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם כִּבְרִ֥ית אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: And Josiah removed all the abominations from all the lands belonging to the Israelites, and he required everyone in Israel to serve the LORD their God. Throughout his reign they did not turn aside from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.
passages.sermon:
Josiah was king of Judah.
Josiah removed all abominations from every land that belonged to the Israelites.
Josiah required everyone found in Israel to serve the LORD their God.
During all the days of Josiah’s life, the people did not turn away from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨סַר יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֜הוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַתּוֹעֵב֗וֹת מִֽכָּל־ הָאֲרָצוֹת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַֽיַּעֲבֵ֗ד אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַנִּמְצָא֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעֲב֖וֹד אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם כָּל־ יָמָ֕יו לֹ֣א סָ֔רוּ מֵֽאַחֲרֵ֕י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃פ
